questions.stem: A patient comes with complaints of Vertigo and dizziness. After doing some clinical tests of vestibular function, you send the patient for the Fitzgerald Hallpike test in which the patient lies supine with head tilted 30 ° forwards, and the ear is irrigated for 40 sec, alternate with warm and cold water. What would you expect when irrigated with cold water?
